title: Maintenance of Centralised Cooling System Unit in Flats in Tengah
what_it_is: Maintenance of Centralised Cooling System Unit in Flats in Tengah

sections.label: Chilled water to HDB homes
sections.summary: Chilled water will be piped to homes from centralised chillers on selected HDB rooftops, with flat owners maintaining in-flat parts and SP Group the rest.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Chilled water will be piped to homes from centralised chillers installed on the rooftops of selected Housing and Development Board (HDB) blocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Flat owners are responsible for the maintenance of the parts of the CCS within the flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The parts of the CCS outside the flat will be maintained by SP Group.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: HDB will study the feasibility of extending the CCS to other new Build-To-Order (BTO) developments.

sections.label: CCS pilot and BTO cost
sections.summary: The CCS pilot design has not added to the cost of BTO units, as flat pricing is based on affordability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The first question the Member is asking is whether the design for the CCS pilot has added to the cost of the BTO units, the answer is no.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The flat pricing, as I said before on various occasions, is based on affordability.

sections.label: CCS viability and take-up
sections.summary: CCS viability depends on take-up, and flats are designed to carry both CCS and split unit systems so owners can switch.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The second question is whether the viability of such a CCS system is dependent on the take-up level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, because when we design this pilot, we make sure that there is competition and contestability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The home owner – either by subscribing to this at the onset or further down as the programme continues – can decide whether to stay on the CCS or to change back to the split unit system because the flats are designed to carry both.
